title: Encoded Max-Three-SAT model
statement: Given a canonical binary encoding of three-CNF formulas, an encoded maximization problem is a model for Max-Three-SAT if every encoded formula is an instance, its optimum on each such encoding is at most $1$, and that optimum equals $1$ if and only if the formula is satisfiable.
hypotheses_covered: A canonical binary encoding of encoded three-CNF formulas
Every encoded formula belongs to the maximization problem's instance set
The optimum on every encoded formula is at most $1$
The optimum on an encoded formula equals $1$ exactly when that formula is satisfiable
